steps.title: Load CSV and set up labware
steps.instruction: Load the CSV file that specifies buffer and sample volumes, rack locations, and destination wells; place a 195 mL reservoir containing buffer, a 96‑well destination plate, and up to three 24‑tube racks with samples on the deck.

substeps.instruction: Open the protocol and upload the CSV file containing the custom volumes and locations.
Place a 195 mL reservoir filled with buffer on the deck.
Place a 96‑well destination plate on the deck.
Place up to three 24‑tube racks (containing the samples) on the deck.

steps.title: Distribute buffer with p300
steps.instruction: Using a single tip on the p300 multi‑channel pipette, dispense the custom buffer volumes (150‑300 µL) from the reservoir into the wells of the destination plate as listed in the CSV.

substeps.instruction: Attach a single tip to the p300 multi‑channel pipette.
For each well listed in the CSV, aspirate the specified buffer volume (150‑300 µL) from the reservoir.
Dispense the aspirated buffer into the corresponding destination well.

steps.title: Mix and transfer samples with p20
steps.instruction: Using the p20 single‑channel pipette, mix each sample source six times, transfer the custom sample volume (2‑15 µL) to the designated destination well, and then mix the destination well three times, all according to the CSV.

substeps.instruction: Attach a tip to the p20 single‑channel pipette.
Aspirate the sample from the specified tube rack well.
Mix the sample source by aspirating and dispensing six times.
Transfer the specified sample volume (2‑15 µL) to the target well in the destination plate.
Mix the destination well by aspirating and dispensing three times.
